PLAN "Upper Body Rebuild - Right Subacromial Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build upper-body strength and scapular control within pain-free range"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Restore pain-free shoulder mobility and climbing-relevant pulling capacity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Pain-Free Rebuild" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper A - Scapular Base":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper B - Pull and Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
